user.title: Add a Cloud Intelligence plug
user.description: Enter the plug's local keys (from the Cloud Intelligence app traffic). Leave IP address blank to find it automatically.

reauth_confirm.title: New keys for {name}
reauth_confirm.description: The plug rejected its keys (it was probably re-paired in the app). Enter the new access key and token.

error.not_found: No plug with that device name answered on the network. Enter its IP address.
error.cannot_connect: The plug didn't answer. Check the IP address and that it's online.
error.invalid_auth: The plug rejected the access key or token.
error.unknown: The plug answered but something went wrong. Check the logs.

data.scan_interval: How often to check the plug's state (seconds)
